messages.subject: Project Larkspur - draft contract - our mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Jonathan,

Our comments on the draft contract will follow tomorrow. Headline points we'll be pushing: reduce the contract rate from 4% to 3% over base; cap the seller's liability at 25% of the price rather than the full price; and shorten the claim notification period from 2 years to 18 months. We also want the rent review conduct and rent deposit assignments dealt with expressly at clause 6.

Elena

messages.subject: RE: Project Larkspur - draft contract - our mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

Thank you for the mark-up. Our client will accept the contract rate at 3% over base and the 18-month notification period. On the liability cap, 25% of the price is agreed given this is an investment sale with full disclosure. We've reflected all three in the revised draft and the express clause 6 provisions on the rent review and deposits.

We should be in a position to exchange on 24 April.

Regards
Jonathan
